notes: Two taḥwīl branches (ح) meet at ابن وهب; the names written once after them (يونس onward) are the shared tail
«أبي، سلمة بن عبد الرحمن» is one man (kunya, comma, name: rule 7) and co-transmits with ابن المسيب
In the story, حمل بن النابغة speaks but is not a link; the Prophet's words are relayed by Abu Hurayra, the last link
